title: Kulbergs delivers damning verdict on Dombrava's immigration wishlist
summary_full: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) delivered a startling put-down of immigration controls tabled by his Interior Minister, Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) on September 1st, suggesting he had achieved too little in the three months he had to prepare it, and had not properly coordinated the actions of the Interior Ministry with all the necessary agencies that should have been consulted.
